sections.title: Guest Rewards Loyalty Program — Earning
sections.heading: Earning points
sections.text: Members earn 10 points per US dollar spent on the room rate. Points are rounded down to a whole number.

sections.title: Guest Rewards Loyalty Program — Earning
sections.heading: What does not earn points
sections.text: Taxes, resort fees and pet fees do not earn points.

sections.title: Guest Rewards Loyalty Program — Earning
sections.heading: Verifying membership
sections.text: Always confirm the member number in the guest's profile. Never grant tier benefits based on a verbal claim alone.

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: How support agents handle a member's request for points they believe are missing from a completed stay.

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Which version applies
sections.text: Use the version of this policy in force on the stay's checkout date, in the property's local time (Eastern).

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Timing
sections.text: A member may claim missing points no earlier than **30 days** after checkout, and no later than **12 months** after checkout. Before 30 days, tell the member the date from which they can claim. After 12 months, the claim is declined.

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Booking channels
sections.text: Stays booked directly (hotel website, app, front desk) or by phone earn points. Stays booked through online travel agencies (OTAs) or travel agents do not earn points.

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Already credited
sections.text: If the ledger already shows the points for the stay, no adjustment is made. Show the member the posting.

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Approval
sections.text: Every adjustment needs a supervisor's approval. A supervisor may approve up to 20,000 points per case; above that, escalate to the loyalty manager.

sections.title: Guest Rewards — Missing Points Requests
sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: If the stay record is missing or records disagree, escalate to the property for confirmation. Do not adjust on the member's documents alone.
